system.name: ProAgent
system.one_liner: LLM-based cooperative agent that infers teammate intentions, plans and verifies skills, and revises its beliefs from the teammate's real behaviour.

content.variant_note: left ring of modules and environment with a teammate loop, plus a zoomed real-text trace of one Overcooked turn on the right
content.argues: A proactive agent can cooperate with unfamiliar teammates by reading the state in language, predicting the teammate's intention, revising that belief from real behaviour, and verifying each skill before acting.
content.subject: ProAgent module ring enlarged into one worked Overcooked turn: prompt, analysis, belief revision, validation, screenshot.

elements.name: state
elements.role: raw environment state entering the agent
elements.drawn_as: cyan box at the top of the ring

elements.name: language state
elements.role: the state translated into natural language for the LLM
elements.drawn_as: beige box inside the dashed ProAgent box

elements.name: (unlabelled) OpenAI logo
elements.role: the LLM-based Planner that analyses the scene, infers the teammate's intention and plans a skill
elements.drawn_as: black knot logo, three copies: ring, framed panel, title

elements.name: belief / plan
elements.role: predicted teammate intention and the skill planned for the agent
elements.drawn_as: two light-blue boxes stacked under the logo

elements.name: verificator
elements.role: checks whether the planned skill can be performed and sends feedback to the LLM when it fails
elements.drawn_as: orange rounded box with a red feedback loop back to the logo; also a tab under the Plan Validation panel

elements.name: controller
elements.role: breaks a valid skill into low-level actions
elements.drawn_as: green rounded box (left) and a tall green box (right)

elements.name: action
elements.role: low-level actions executed in the environment
elements.drawn_as: grey-blue box at the bottom of the ring

elements.name: memory
elements.role: stores history that the Planner reads
elements.drawn_as: tall yellow-orange bar (left) and a wide bar along the bottom (right)

elements.name: knowledge
elements.role: task knowledge fed to memory and to the prompt
elements.drawn_as: grey label box with a peach arrow into memory (left); first prompt block (right)

elements.name: environment
elements.role: the shared world both agents act in
elements.drawn_as: tall blue box on the right of the ring

elements.name: (unlabelled) orange robot / Bob
elements.role: the teammate agent; its decision loop is the blue ring of arrows
elements.drawn_as: cartoon robot at the left of the ring; again at the bottom right with the bold label Bob

elements.name: feedback
elements.role: the red loop from verificator back to the LLM
elements.drawn_as: red rotated text along a red arrow (left); red-bordered rounded vertical box (right)

elements.name: ProAgent / teammate / loop / store key
elements.role: tells the four kinds of arrow apart
elements.drawn_as: four sample arrows with words and a small dashed box, at the bottom left

elements.name: Prompt: knowledge, state, belief
elements.role: inputs to the LLM, with real strings
elements.drawn_as: three tinted text blocks (light grey, beige, light blue) with small tab labels, gathered by a curly brace

elements.name: Analysis: The pot is empty. Both You and Bob have empty hands.
elements.role: the LLM's analysis of the scene
elements.drawn_as: red dashed box with italic text

elements.name: Plan of you / Intention of Bob / Real behavior of Bob
elements.role: planned skill, predicted teammate intention and the teammate's observed action
elements.drawn_as: three blue dashed boxes with italic text, names in colour

elements.name: Belief Revision
elements.role: compares the predicted intention with the real behaviour and corrects the belief
elements.drawn_as: beige rounded box with grey arrows from the two blue boxes

elements.name: I succeeded at pickup(onion)
elements.role: success message between Achieved! and the controller (role read from the drawing)
elements.drawn_as: grey box joined by grey elbow connectors

encoding.marker_means: no numbers; Fail? and Achieved! name the two outcomes of validation; coloured words mark who is who

lessons.what_to_learn: Pair a small ring that shows who acts with a dashed wedge into a large framed panel that replays one real turn with actual prompt and output strings, keeping module names and colours identical in both and explaining arrow colours with a four-arrow key.
lessons.suits: LLM-agent frameworks with a plan-verify-act loop, memory and a second agent, where a real example turn makes the pipeline concrete.

evidence: Overview of our proposed ProAgent framework including the coordination task workflow (left) and inner details of ProAgent pipeline (right).
The teammate agent’s decision-making loop is formed by the blue solid arrows in the outer circle
ProAgent enters into a re-plan loop, initiating a recalibration process.

summary: ProAgent is an LLM-based cooperative agent that infers what its teammate will do, plans a skill, revises its belief from the teammate's real behaviour, verifies the skill and executes it, tested in Overcooked-AI. The figure joins two units by a dashed zoom wedge. At left, a small workflow ring shows state, language state, the LLM (OpenAI logo), belief, plan, verificator, controller and action, with a memory bar and the teammate's own blue loop around the environment. At right, a large framed panel replays one turn with real text: prompt blocks (knowledge, state, belief), the analysis, the plan and teammate intention, belief revision, plan validation with a red reflection loop, then the controller and a game screenshot. A key of four arrow colours explains the flows.

notes: Kinds extend the prior (actor-interaction, worked-walkthrough) with stage-pipeline, because the right half is also the five-stage inference pipeline of the text. The role of the grey 'I succeeded at pickup(onion)' box between Achieved! and the controller is read from the connectors only.
